reasons: CS2109HS is not open to BComp CS Hons students (not open to PROGRAMS 0300CSHON).
CS2109HS is offered only in Sem 1, but next semester from semester 3 is semester 4 (Sem 2), so it is not offered then.
Although the prerequisite CS2040S and a qualifying math course (MA1521) are completed, the course is still not eligible due to the programme restriction and semester offering.
